title: AI Engineering Harness Configuration
description: Syntax schema for .harness/harness.yaml. Validates structure only; does not resolve whether referenced profiles, rules, skills, or tools exist.

version.description: Harness configuration format version. Increment when the configuration contract changes incompatibly.

profile.description: Profile identifier (kebab-case). Semantic resolution checks that profiles/<name>.yaml exists.

rules.description: When present, replaces the Profile rules list entirely. When omitted, Profile rules are used.

skills.description: When present, replaces the Profile skills list entirely. When omitted, Profile skills are used.

tools.description: When present, replaces the Profile tools list entirely. When omitted, Profile tools are used. Entries may be a name string or an object with optional metadata.
